title: CLI Reference
description: Technical cheat sheet of all commands.

sections.title: Command Summary
sections.content: A quick reference for all available CLI operations used to scaffold your Express.js project and generate CRUD resources.

examples.code:
| Command | Alias | Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| nb init | -i | Sets up a new project |
| nb | (no args) | Opens interactive menu |
| nb -r <name> | -r | Creates Route + Controller |
| nb -c <name> | -c | Creates only Controller |
| nb -h | -h | Shows this menu |
